# PageHeader

The title block of a screen with no subject: sign-in, onboarding, the paywall.

`NomNom.PageHeader` · Layout

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.PageHeader title={…}>…</NomNom.PageHeader>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.PageHeader" title="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

The title block of a screen with no subject: sign-in, onboarding, paywall. A fixed composition of SectionHeader, Text and AppButton — it owns the type steps, the measure and the single h1, the way Section and SectionCard own theirs.

## Props (PageHeaderProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `unknown` |  |
| `subtitle` | `unknown` |  |
| `eyebrow` | `string` | An uppercase eyebrow above the title (a SectionHeader). |
| `actions` | `EmptyStateAction[]` | AppButtons the header builds: the first solid, the rest ghost. Full width when centred. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | 'sm' drops the title to serif-md and the actions to md. @default 'md' |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'center'` |  |
| `children` | `unknown` |  |
